name: Hunting Blinds

end_product.name: hard-sided hunting blind
end_product.description: An enclosed, hard-sided structure that hunters sit in to stay hidden from game, usually with windows and a door. Includes box blinds, elevated or tower blinds, tripod blinds, ground box blinds, and shooting houses, made of fiberglass, plastic, wood, or metal.
not_included: Soft-sided, fabric, and pop-up blinds (they do not use windows).
Waterfowl, duck, and layout blinds, including permanent hard-sided duck blinds.
Open tree stands, ladder stands, and stands without an enclosure.
General sheds, cabins, or agricultural buildings unless the company shows it builds hunting blinds.

our_products.summary: aluminum and vinyl windows and aluminum-framed doors for hunting blinds

notes: Shed, cabin, and outdoor-structure builders that list hunting blinds among their products are IN under rule A.
Dealers and retailers that only resell finished blinds are OUT.
Other hunting products (feeders, stands, trail cameras, apparel, firearms, optics, decoys) are OUT.
Outfitters, ranches, hunting preserves, and blind rental companies are OUT.

examples_in.name: The Original Deer Blind Window Company

geography.note: Contiguous United States only. Texas and the Midwest have the highest concentration.
